faq.metaDescription: Straight answers about privacy, earnings, content, contracts and how a partnership with KARAY Models actually works.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Straight answers to the questions a prospective model usually asks before joining our agency.
faq.highlightTitle: Yes, you can block Brazil or any other country on OnlyFans.
faq.highlightBody: It's the question we're asked most often, so it's the first one we answer.
faq.ctaHeadline: Talk to our team before you decide.
faq.ctaBody: We want you to fully understand how the partnership works before you commit to anything.

questions.question: Can I block Brazil on OnlyFans?
answer: Yes. This is the question we get most often from Brazilian applicants.
OnlyFans has geo-blocking features. We can block Brazil, or any other countries you choose, to reduce the chance of people in those places finding or reaching your page.
No feature offers absolute anonymity online, but geo-blocking is an important step toward greater privacy.

questions.question: Could my family or friends find out?
answer: No serious agency can guarantee that will never happen. What we can do is use strategies that reduce the risk considerably.

Those measures can include geo-blocking, professional accounts kept separate from personal ones, a dedicated residential proxy, a dedicated browser profile, targeted marketing and guidance on digital privacy.

questions.question: Do I have to show my face?
answer: Not necessarily.
Some models show their face; others use strategic framing, masks, lighting, editing or content with no facial identification at all.
The strategy is built around your goals, your boundaries and your comfort level.

questions.question: How much can I earn?
answer: There is no guaranteed income. Anyone promising guaranteed earnings is not being honest with you.
Results depend on how often you post and the quality of it, consistency, niche, positioning, marketing, subscriber interaction and how readily strategies are adapted.
Our goal is to build consistent, sustainable income without selling unrealistic expectations.

questions.question: How are earnings split?
answer: After platform fees, the standard split is 60% to the model, 20% to agency management and 20% to the marketing company.
For the first three months we usually waive our 20% management fee, so the model keeps a larger share while the account is still being built.
Every term is presented clearly before the partnership begins and written into the contract.

questions.question: Can I be paid in reais or in dollars?
answer: Yes. Depending on the method agreed, your payouts can be made in reais or in dollars.
Before the partnership starts we put in writing the currency, the payment schedule, the applicable conversion rates and the method used.

questions.question: Can the money be deposited straight into my account?
answer: Yes, that arrangement can be made available.
When platform payments go directly to the model's account, she becomes responsible for transferring the agency's and the marketing company's contracted percentages within the agreed deadlines.
This arrangement requires responsibility, financial organization and punctuality. Missing a payment is a breach of contract.

questions.question: Why is there an extra charge in the seventh month when I'm paid directly?
answer: When a model chooses to be paid directly, the agency takes on the risk of investing in infrastructure, technology, marketing and daily work without direct control over the percentages owed to it.
After six full months of partnership, a one-time additional amount equal to 20% of that month's net earnings is charged in the seventh month, as set out in the contract.
This should be understood as a deposit or security reserve that protects the continuity of the partnership and reduces the risk of future non-payment.
It is charged only once. The calculation, the due date and all conditions are explained before the contract is signed.

questions.question: Could being paid directly affect my Bolsa Família benefit?
answer: Yes, it can.

Some applicants and models belong to households that receive Bolsa Família. Once significant amounts start arriving directly in the model's bank account, those earnings may be counted in the assessment of household income.
Depending on the amount received, the household's per-person income and the rules in force, the benefit may be reduced, placed under a protection rule, suspended or ended.
We include this warning so that every model makes an informed decision before choosing to be paid directly.
The model should keep her Cadastro Único up to date and consult CRAS or a qualified professional about her specific situation.
The agency will never advise a model to hide income, withhold information or give incorrect data to the government.

questions.question: Who is responsible for taxes?
answer: Each model is responsible for her own filings, tax obligations and any taxes due in her country of residence.
The agency is not a substitute for an accountant, a lawyer or a tax adviser. Where needed, we recommend consulting a qualified professional.

questions.question: Do I have to produce content every day?
answer: You are not required to produce new content every day.
That said, your income tends to track directly with how often you send content, how much of it, and how good it is.
The more quality material we have on hand, the better we can keep your page active, plan posts, run campaigns, produce varied PPVs, test formats and keep subscribers interested.
A model who rarely sends content directly limits what the agency can do — and with it, her own earning potential.
We'll build a realistic production plan around your routine, but consistency will always matter.

questions.question: How do I send my photos and videos to the agency?
answer: Content is sent through a private Google Drive folder or a shared Google Photos album.
We don't recommend sending your main files over WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or similar apps, since those platforms compress photos and videos and degrade the quality.
When using Google Photos, select the original-quality option so the files keep their full resolution.
Our team organizes the folders by date, content type, campaign or category to make planning and publishing easier.

questions.question: Do I need professional equipment?
answer: Not necessarily.
A modern phone, good lighting, a tidy space and attention to framing can produce excellent content.
Our team provides guidance on lighting, settings, posing, formats and how to organize your files.

questions.question: Do I need experience?
answer: No.
We work with beginners as well as models who already have experience. Our team guides every stage of creating, positioning and developing your brand.

questions.question: Does the agency create all the accounts?
answer: Yes. Depending on the strategy, our team can create and configure OnlyFans, X, Instagram, Reddit, TikTok, a professional email address, a links page and any other promotional accounts needed.
All of them are set up to our security and operating standards before the brand officially launches.

questions.question: Can I keep using an account I already have?
answer: Yes.
We can also manage an OnlyFans account that existed before the partnership. Because that means additional work, an extra 5% may be charged.
The main marketing investment stays focused on the account the agency builds.

questions.question: What is a residential proxy?
answer: It's a technology used to keep a stable, consistent residential connection while the account is managed.
Each model gets her own dedicated static residential proxy. This helps reduce the risks that come with an account being accessed from different countries, internet addresses and devices.

questions.question: What does the agency invest in me?
answer: We invest time, experience, technology, infrastructure and money in developing your brand.

That can include a dedicated residential proxy, a dedicated browser profile, professional marketing tools, analytics systems, content planning, day-to-day management, technical support, sales strategy and long-term development.
These resources are provided by the agency at no separate charge during the partnership, except where the contract specifies otherwise.

questions.question: Who talks to the subscribers?
answer: Our professional chatter team.
The work includes fast replies, building relationships, PPV sales, encouraging tips, subscriber retention and engaging conversation.
All of it respects the boundaries, preferences and rules you set.

questions.question: How many models does the agency manage?
answer: Our agency works with a maximum of 30 active models.
We would rather offer individual attention, constant communication and tailored strategies than manage hundreds of accounts without proper care.

questions.question: Can I leave the agency whenever I want?
answer: Yes. You can end the partnership at any time, following the procedure and conditions described in the contract.
If you decide to leave, we remove our access and handle the separation professionally and respectfully.
The main OnlyFans account created, structured and developed by the agency will be closed and will not be transferred to the model.
That is because the account represents an investment the agency made in branding, marketing, infrastructure, strategy, technology and business development.
If the model already had an account before the partnership and only contracted the additional management, that account remains hers and we remove our access when the partnership ends.

questions.question: Is there a long-term contract?
answer: We intend to build a lasting partnership, but it should continue because both sides are happy with the relationship and the results.
Cancellation procedures, financial responsibilities, account ownership and how operations wind down are all explained clearly in the contract.

questions.question: How do I join the agency?
answer: Click the Apply button and fill in the application form.
Once we receive your application we review your profile, get in touch, answer your questions and explain the process before any commitment.

recordingGuidelines.title: Recording Guidelines
recordingGuidelines.intro: Follow these guidelines to keep the quality of the content you send to Google Drive.

sections.title: Lighting
items: Always face the light — never shoot with the window or light source behind you.
Natural light or a ring light works best; avoid very dark rooms.

sections.title: Resolution and framing
items: Record at the highest resolution your phone offers (1080p minimum).
Keep the phone steady — use a tripod whenever you can.
Frame vertically for Stories/Reels, and horizontally when the team asks for it.

sections.title: Audio
items: Record somewhere quiet, with no fans, TV or background music.
Keep wind off the microphone when recording outdoors.

sections.title: Sending it in
items: Send content as soon as you can after recording, without editing it first.
Separate photos and videos by date where possible.
If you're unsure what to record, message the team on WhatsApp first.

googlePhotos.title: How to share your photos with Google Photos
googlePhotos.intro: Create an album with two vertical photos and two horizontal ones. Then copy the shareable link and paste it into the KARAY Models form.
checklist: Use sharp photos without heavy filters.
There's no need to send explicit content.
Check that anyone with the link can view the album.
googlePhotos.testLink: Test the link before sending it
googlePhotos.testLinkBody: Open the link in a private window, or send it to someone you trust. If the photos appear without asking for permission, the link is set up correctly.

iphoneSteps.title: Open Google Photos
iphoneSteps.text: Open the Google Photos app on your iPhone. If you don't have it yet, install it from the App Store and sign in with your Google account.

iphoneSteps.title: Select the four photos
iphoneSteps.text: Choose two recent vertical photos and two horizontal ones. There's no need to send explicit content.

iphoneSteps.title: Create an album
iphoneSteps.text: Tap “Add to” or the “+” symbol and choose “Album”. Name the album “KARAY Models Application”.

iphoneSteps.title: Check the album
iphoneSteps.text: Open the album and confirm all four photos appear correctly.

iphoneSteps.title: Share the album
iphoneSteps.text: Tap the share icon, then choose “Create link”, “Get link” or “Share link”.

iphoneSteps.title: Copy the link
iphoneSteps.text: Copy the link Google Photos created and go back to the KARAY Models form.

iphoneSteps.title: Paste the link into the form
iphoneSteps.text: Paste the link into the field on the application and check that it starts with photos.app.goo.gl or photos.google.com.

androidSteps.title: Open Google Photos
androidSteps.text: Open the Google Photos app on your Android phone and confirm you're signed in to your Google account.

androidSteps.title: Select the four photos
androidSteps.text: Choose two recent vertical photos and two horizontal ones — sharp, and without filters that significantly change how you look.

androidSteps.title: Create an album
androidSteps.text: Tap “Add to”, “+” or “New” and select “Album”. Name the album “KARAY Models Application”.

androidSteps.title: Check the album
androidSteps.text: Open the album and confirm all four photos are there.

androidSteps.title: Create the link
androidSteps.text: Tap “Share” and then “Create link”. On some phones this appears as “Get link”.

androidSteps.title: Copy the link
androidSteps.text: Tap “Copy link” and return to the application form.

androidSteps.title: Paste the link into the form
androidSteps.text: Paste the link into the Google Photos field and carry on with the rest of the application.

model_details.title: Model details recorded
model_details.description: Actress name, OnlyFans username, e-mail and phone checked. The actress name and the OnlyFans username are different — never swap one for the other.

secondary_email.title: Secondary e-mail
secondary_email.description: A second contact e-mail, where one exists. If the model does not have one, tick the box to skip it — the step counts as complete either way, and stays pending while neither is filled in.

social_media_links.title: Social media links recorded
social_media_links.description: Every profile used for promotion, plus the personal Instagram that must not appear anywhere.

identity_confirmation.title: Identity confirmation
identity_confirmation.description: Submit an official document with a sharp photo and the legal name details. The name on OnlyFans must match the one on the document.

social_media_linking.title: Social media linking
social_media_linking.description: Connect Instagram, Twitter, TikTok and Reddit for verification and cross-promotion. Post the verification announcements on the platforms.

bank_account_setup.title: Bank account setup
bank_account_setup.description: Link a personal or business bank account to receive payouts. Check which methods OnlyFans accepts in the model's country.

approval_timeline.title: Approval timeline tracked
approval_timeline.description: Start verification as early as possible: approval takes anywhere from 24 hours to a few days. If it takes longer, contact OnlyFans support.

username_selection.title: Username chosen
username_selection.description: Short, memorable, aligned with the niche and representing the model's brand.

profile_photo.title: Profile photo published
profile_photo.description: A professional, well-lit photo showing the face or the brand identity.

banner_image.title: Banner published
banner_image.description: A banner that matches the content theme and complements the brand. Use Canva or Photoshop for a professional finish.

bio_description.title: Bio written
bio_description.description: A concise, engaging bio that makes the niche clear and says what subscribers can expect.

call_to_action.title: Call to action included
call_to_action.description: For example: "Subscribe for exclusive content every day!".

content_previews.title: Content previews published
content_previews.description: Pin a sample post that shows the quality of the content to people who have not subscribed yet.

visibility_settings.title: Visibility settings adjusted
visibility_settings.description: At the start, hide likes and follower counts so potential subscribers are not put off.

subscription_model.title: Subscription model decided
subscription_model.description: Free page: draws a wider audience, but depends on selling content and messages (PPV). Paid page: direct, guaranteed subscription revenue with PPV on top, but needs more aggressive promotion.

seo_optimization.title: SEO optimisation
seo_optimization.description: Use relevant keywords in the bio and post descriptions to improve discovery.

hashtag_usage.title: Hashtag usage
hashtag_usage.description: Research and use trending, niche-specific hashtags to increase reach.

internal_linking.title: Internal linking between posts
internal_linking.description: Promote older posts by linking them to related content in the captions.

subscriber_lists.title: Subscriber lists set up
subscriber_lists.description: Use the "Lists" feature to group subscribers by interest and spend, and send targeted promotions.

niche_identification.title: Niche identified
niche_identification.description: Define a clear differentiator and a consistent theme (fitness, cosplay, glamour, and so on).

content_planning.title: Content planning
content_planning.description: Build a weekly/monthly calendar with posts, stories and engagement activity planned in advance.

quality_assurance.title: Quality assurance
quality_assurance.description: Invest in proper lighting, an HD camera and editing tools to keep production value high.

social_media_integration.title: Social media integration
social_media_integration.description: Promote OnlyFans on Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, Reddit and Telegram, posting previews consistently across every platform.

collaborations.title: Collaborations
collaborations.description: Set up partnerships with other creators for cross-promotion, collabs and an engagement boost.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Reply to messages daily, run Q&As and go live to build a loyal community.

contracts.title: Contracts signed
contracts.description: A legally binding agreement between the model and the agency, setting out content rights in a legal document.

tax_compliance.title: Tax position handled
tax_compliance.description: Talk through the tax obligations on OnlyFans earnings and recommend an accountant where needed.

content_rights.title: Content rights settled
content_rights.description: Make clear who owns the content and how it may be distributed. Register the rights and monitor for piracy.

analytics_monitoring.title: Analytics monitoring
analytics_monitoring.description: Track subscriber growth and engagement rates, and check which content performs best.

feedback_collection.title: Feedback collection
feedback_collection.description: Ask subscribers what they want to see more of and use it to refine the content.

professional_development.title: Professional development
professional_development.description: Keep up with OnlyFans features and marketing trends.

skip_secondary_email.label: Not applicable / skip the secondary e-mail

x_posts.title: X: 3 posts (15 min)
x_posts.description: Three posts on X/Twitter: one hook, one tease and one call to action.

reddit_rounds.title: Reddit: 5 subreddits (25 min)
reddit_rounds.description: Post in five different subreddits, respecting each one's rules.

short_video.title: Instagram/TikTok: 1 reel (15 min)
short_video.description: One short video of 7 to 12 seconds, with a visual hook in the first two seconds.

collab_outreach.title: Outreach: 10 DMs (10 min)
collab_outreach.description: Ten messages to creators in the same niche proposing a mutual shoutout.

onlyfans_post_and_dms.title: OnlyFans: 1 post + reply to DMs (10–20 min)
onlyfans_post_and_dms.description: One feed post and a reply to every message of the day.

feed_post.title: Post to the feed
feed_post.description: At least one new post a day — it is what keeps the subscription worth paying for.

pinned_and_menu.title: Check pinned posts and menu
pinned_and_menu.description: Best photo set, best video teaser and the price menu at the top of the profile.

active_offer.title: Keep one offer running
active_offer.description: A limited-time discount, a free trial or a bundle — the page is never without a reason to subscribe today.

welcome_ppv.title: Welcome message + entry PPV
welcome_ppv.description: The automatic message and a cheap PPV within the first 24 hours: the moment a new subscriber is most likely to buy.

check_analytics.title: Check the day's numbers
check_analytics.description: New subscribers, cancellations, what sold best and where the traffic came from.

read_handoff.title: Read the previous shift's hand-off
read_handoff.description: Start knowing what was already said, promised and sold.

answer_all_dms.title: Answer every DM
answer_all_dms.description: No message is left unanswered by the end of the shift. A fast reply is what converts.

proactive_outreach.title: Message the people who already spent
proactive_outreach.description: Talk to the biggest spenders and the warm fans, referencing what each one bought or asked for — nothing generic.

mass_message.title: Mass message (2 to 3 a week at most)
mass_message.description: Copy that reads personally, sent by list. More than that burns the base out.

ppv_drop.title: Send the day's PPV
ppv_drop.description: Paid content with the teaser and the price decided before it goes out.

unsend_expired.title: Unsend unbought PPV
unsend_expired.description: Pull it after 2 to 4 days, so a stale offer is not left hanging in the fan's inbox.

write_handoff.title: Write the shift hand-off
write_handoff.description: Who bought, who is warm, and what was promised for the next shift.

pre_renewal_touch.title: Pre-renewal touch
pre_renewal_touch.description: Three to five days before the renewal, remind the subscriber why they subscribed and what is coming next.

winback_first_touch.title: Win-back touch 1 (day 1)
winback_first_touch.description: Whoever just cancelled gets a tease of what they are missing — no desperation and no discount yet.

winback_discount.title: Win-back touch 2 (days 5 to 7)
winback_discount.description: Now with a real incentive: a discounted renewal for one month.

thank_spenders.title: Thank tips and purchases
thank_spenders.description: A personal message for every purchase of the day. It is what makes a fan buy again.

track_rebill.title: Track the rebill rate
track_rebill.description: Record how many renewed and how many cancelled, so it is clear whether retention is rising or falling.

daily_posts.title: Post 3 to 6 times
daily_posts.description: Mix media and personality through the day, not all at once.

post_formula.title: Follow the hook / tease / CTA formula
post_formula.description: Each block of the day has one hook post, one short tease and one conversion post.

peak_hours.title: Post at peak hours
peak_hours.description: Concentrate the main posts late in the evening, when the adult audience is online.

hashtags.title: Use 3 to 5 strong hashtags
hashtags.description: Niche hashtags, no banned or ghosted tags.

reply_big_accounts.title: Reply early under big accounts
reply_big_accounts.description: Find 10 large accounts in the niche and reply within 10 to 20 minutes of their post.

like_and_follow.title: Like 20 posts and follow 10 accounts
like_and_follow.description: The daily networking pass — it is what makes the profile show up.

dm_engagers.title: DM 10 people who engaged
dm_engagers.description: Use the message script with anyone who liked or commented.

pinned_tweet.title: Check the pinned tweet
pinned_tweet.description: The pinned post leads to the link and is still current.

sfs_retweets.title: SFS and promo-account retweets
sfs_retweets.description: Cross-promotion with creators and promo pages.

post_subreddits.title: Post in 5 to 10 subreddits
post_subreddits.description: Different subreddits, matching the niche and the model's look.

check_rules.title: Read the rules before posting
check_rules.description: Each sub has its own posting limit, verification requirement and link rule.

verification_and_karma.title: Keep karma and verifications current
verification_and_karma.description: The big subs want an account older than 30 days, accumulated karma and a verification photo with the sub's name handwritten.

native_upload.title: Upload media natively, no direct link
native_upload.description: Image or video uploaded to Reddit itself; if links are banned, say it is on the profile.

hook_titles.title: Title with a hook
hook_titles.description: A short question or tease, not a description of what is in the photo.

post_timing.title: Post on the audience's clock
post_timing.description: The first upvotes decide where a post lands: posting at 3am buries what would climb at 8pm.

reply_comments.title: Reply to comments for 30 minutes
reply_comments.description: Engagement right after posting is what pushes it up the sub.

track_results.title: Note which subs performed
track_results.description: Record where the profile clicks came from so tomorrow repeats what works.

stories.title: Post 3 to 5 Stories
stories.description: Behind the scenes, routine and light teasing — nothing explicit.

feed_or_reel.title: 1 feed post or 1 Reel
feed_or_reel.description: New content on the profile, with a trending audio where it fits.

engage_niche.title: Like and comment on niche profiles
engage_niche.description: Daily engagement with similar accounts to show up in explore.

fast_dm_reply.title: Answer DMs within the hour
fast_dm_reply.description: Replying while they are still there converts far better than replying at the end of the day — a delay lets the lead go cold.

comment_to_dm.title: Move comments into the DM
comment_to_dm.description: Anyone who commented asking for the link gets a direct message with the way to the page.

story_interaction.title: Poll or question box
story_interaction.description: One interaction sticker a day in Stories.

welcome_dm.title: Welcome DM to new followers
welcome_dm.description: A short, friendly DM to whoever followed today.

check_bio_link.title: Check the bio link
check_bio_link.description: The Linktree or landing page is live and pointing where it should.

videos.title: Post 1 to 3 videos
videos.description: Volume is what drives reach on TikTok.

trending_audio.title: Use a trending sound and format
trending_audio.description: Ride the day's trend without straying from the niche.

hook_and_watermark.title: Hook in the first 2 seconds and watermark
hook_and_watermark.description: Catch the eye immediately and keep the username visible on the video.

reply_comments.title: Reply to comments
reply_comments.description: Reply in text and, when it is worth it, record a video reply.

pinned_comment_funnel.title: Pinned comment pointing to the funnel
pinned_comment_funnel.description: A comment of your own pointing to the Instagram bio.

peak_hours.title: Post at peak hours
peak_hours.description: Test and repeat the times that brought the most views.

youtube_short.title: Post 1 Short
youtube_short.description: Repurpose the day's TikTok or Reel, without the other network's watermark.

youtube_comments.title: Reply to YouTube comments
youtube_comments.description: Engage, and point back to the link in the description and About section.

facebook_post.title: 1 Facebook post
facebook_post.description: PG-13 content, mixing personal life with light teasing.

facebook_groups.title: Take part in groups
facebook_groups.description: Post and comment in promo groups, no spam and within the rules.

facebook_dms.title: Answer reactions and DMs
facebook_dms.description: Talk to whoever reacted to the posts and steer the conversation to the link.

find_creators.title: Find creators in the same niche
find_creators.description: Profiles with an audience similar in size and in style.

send_sfs_dms.title: Propose SFS by DM
send_sfs_dms.description: A shoutout-for-shoutout proposal to the creators picked today.

deliver_agreed_posts.title: Deliver the agreed shoutouts
deliver_agreed_posts.description: Post what was promised to each partner, at the agreed time.

track_collab_results.title: Record how each partnership did
track_collab_results.description: New followers and new subscribers per partner, to keep the best five.

tracked_links.title: Measure clicks by source
tracked_links.description: One tracked link per platform. Without it there is no way to know which network is paying for the day.

backup_content.title: Back up the day's content off-platform
backup_content.description: Keep the published files where no platform can delete them.

proxy_check.title: Check the model's proxy or VPN
proxy_check.description: Each account accessed from the right IP — it is what avoids a ban.

avoid_banned_words.title: Avoid banned terms
avoid_banned_words.description: Do not write “OnlyFans” where the platform punishes it; say “my page” or “my link”.

screenshot_posts.title: Screenshot the important posts
screenshot_posts.description: A record of what went out, in case the platform takes it down.
